title: Basin-lake family-care migrant foundational body plan
scope: Foundational body plan, locomotor structures, and mobile-refuge care interface for the family-care migrant governed by WLD-ECOLOGY-006. Exact migration performance, outlet mechanics, internal physiology, reproduction, Mana use, taxonomy, progression, and human knowledge remain open.
approval_evidence: After three complete visual body-plan cards were displayed and chat confirmation was required, the Author replied 'A' on 2026-08-14, selecting 'A — Brood-Vault Strider'.
question: What foundational body plan and directly visible caregiving interface should govern WLD-ECOLOGY-006's family-care migrant?
selection: Use A — BROOD-VAULT STRIDER. The established caregiving migratory form is a low, three-lobed or broadly tri-radial living vault. A ring of short hydrostatic paddle-columns forms part of its locomotor structure, and travelling waves move along the body margin and contribute to locomotion without yet fixing their mechanical relationship to the columns. The underside forms a mobile refuge. Mobile young shelter beneath it, spill outward to forage, and regroup beneath the refuge. The option retains a qualitative high-drag and route-feasibility concern without establishing outlet passability, bottom-resting behaviour, or a route solution.
alternatives: A — BROOD-VAULT STRIDER: low three-lobed living vault with a ring of hydrostatic paddle-columns, travelling margin waves, and a mobile underside refuge; selected.
B — HELIX-TOW ESCORT: stiff spindle with three helical wave-bands, a patrolled foraging court, and temporary breakaway tow-filaments; not selected.
C — FOLD-CAGE ROSETTE: central barrel with seven muscular vanes that propel, fold for migration, and flare as a perforated refuge; not selected.
rationale: The selected package makes family care physically visible, creates a strong alien contrast with the mass breeder, and supports mobile young that forage outward and regroup without requiring attachment or permanent carriage. Its high-drag concern remains an explicit feasibility gate instead of being hidden by a cost-free movement or Mana solution.
evidence: Author selection on 2026-08-14: after all three complete visual option cards were displayed, the Author replied 'A'.
consequences: The selected foundation governs the family-care migrant's established caregiving migratory form only; juvenile morphology and all other life-stage anatomy remain open.

Brood-Vault Strider, living vault, tri-radial, hydrostatic paddle-column, and mobile refuge are author-facing functional or editorial descriptions, not in-world names, formal taxonomy, or Earth homologies.
Three-lobed or tri-radial qualifies the vault shape only and does not establish exact symmetry, three paddle fields, repeated organs, three identities, or juvenile morphology.

A ring of short hydrostatic paddle-columns and travelling waves along the body margin contribute to locomotion, but exact number, spacing, anatomy, pressure mechanism, actuation, gait, substrate use, and mechanical relationship remain open.

The underside refuge moves with the caregiving form; mobile young shelter beneath it, forage outward, and regroup, without establishing a sealed pouch, permanent carriage, attachment, guaranteed return, provisioning, retrieval, or predator-proof protection.

The high-drag concern makes route geometry, depth, current, body condition, and resting opportunities possible future gates but establishes no passable shallows, bottom-resting stage, outlet mechanism, speed, endurance, survival, or guaranteed return.
WLD-ECOLOGY-006 continues to govern seasonal timing, juvenile diet, competition, predation and harvest, escorted departure, mortality, recruitment, and population variability.
The family-care form does not inherit the mass breeder's body plan, salt organs, gel chambers, buoyancy strategy, or Mana support.

Finite matter or material and usable-energy inputs, internal transport, heat and waste handling, maintenance, injury, disease, recovery, repair, reproduction, route capacity, mortality, and carrying capacity remain causal; no pooled family identity, shared progression, automatic prey-power transfer, Skill, class, reward, spawn, reset, refill, or guaranteed recovery is created.
residual_unknowns: Name, taxonomy, ancestry, species variation, size, proportions, colour, texture, composition, dimorphism, and juvenile morphology remain open.
Exact symmetry, orientation, senses, feeding anatomy, respiration, circulation, nervous system, and internal organ arrangement remain open.
Paddle-column number, spacing, pressure source, anatomy, control, repair, failure, gait, steering, stability, and substrate or free-water interaction remain open.
Margin-wave mechanics, energetic cost, control, and relation to the paddle-columns remain open.
Refuge capacity, ventilation, protection, attachment, use during travel, foraging radius and cues, regrouping timing, and failure remain open.
Reproduction, birth or hatching, carers, sexes, kinship, brood size, provisioning, guarding, retrieval, signalling, and escort formation remain open.
Adult diet and the young's diet beyond the accepted prey relationship remain open.
Buoyancy, osmoregulation, respiration, salinity tolerance, outlet passage, holding sites, route depth, substrate use, speed, endurance, fatigue, and survival remain open.
Mana source, carrier, circulation, effect, cost, recovery, and failure remain open; all Skills, classes, levels, appraisal, cognition, and sapience remain open.
Human and protagonist observation, knowledge, use, naming, and belief remain open.
reopening_conditions: Later hydrodynamic, route, salinity, respiration, or care-capacity modelling cannot support spring arrival, one-season rearing, or pre-freeze seaward departure.
Later accepted ecology or story canon creates a concrete contradiction.
The Author explicitly requests a different foundational body plan or care interface.
